what: Re-count of discovery BAMs (SWGCohort/dna_seq_bam) into the 61,775 hg38 50 kb bins from a discovery 50.QDNAseq.RData, compared bin by bin with the stored 50.raw_read_counts.txt (made 2025-03-12 with QDNAseq 1.38, minMapq 37, pairedEnds FALSE)
counting_rule: records with flag & 0x604 == 0 (mapped, not QC-fail, not duplicate), MAPQ >= 37, secondary/supplementary not filtered, binned by leftmost POS; chr prefix stripped
